## About MEEHAAN Enterprise
MEEHAAN Enterprise is a B2B company specializing in industrial supply from Pune, Maharashtra, India. Established in 2018, the company serves 500+ clients across manufacturing, automotive, and energy sectors with 1,000+ products in inventory.

**Company Facts:**
- Founded: 2018
- Headquarters: Gat No.1326, Unit-II, Shelarvasti, Chikhali, Pune 411062, Maharashtra, India
- Phone: +91 99235 88450
- Website: https://www.meehaan.com
- Primary markets: India and global

---

## Industrial Oils (LUBO Brand)
MEEHAAN supplies LUBO-certified industrial lubricants for manufacturing, automotive, and energy sectors. Product categories include:
- Heat treatment oils (for die casting, forging, hardening)
- Metalworking fluids (cutting coolants, forming fluids)
- Rust preventives and protective oils
- Industrial cleaners and degreasing agents
- Fire-resistant hydraulic fluids
- Die casting release agents

All oils meet OEM specifications and come with technical data sheets (TDS) available on request.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/industrial/oils

## Automotive Connectors
Authorized distributor for 13+ global connector brands:
- Yazaki
- Sumitomo
- TE Connectivity
- Molex
- JST
- And 8+ additional brands

Specialties: High-temperature connectors, sealed connectors for EV applications, OEM-grade connectors for Tier-1 automotive suppliers.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/industrial/connectors

## Battery Accessories for EV & Solar
Supplied to EV manufacturers and solar energy companies:
- FRP (Fiber Reinforced Plastic) insulation sheets
- Epoxy insulation materials
- Panel terminal blocks
- Anderson connectors for high-current applications
- Degson energy storage connectors
- Custom battery assembly components

All products meet RoHS compliance and automotive-grade specifications.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/industrial/battery

## Oil & Gas Specialization
MEEHAAN manufactures and supplies industrial oils specifically for oil & gas industry applications:
- Downstream refining equipment lubrication
- Upstream drilling fluid support
- Petrochemical processing oils
- Hydraulic fluids for harsh environments (fire-resistant grades)
- Specialty greases for bearing applications
- Equipment maintenance and operational fluids

Manufacturing Capacity: 100-500 tons annually with quality control certifications for oil & gas specifications.
Contact for technical consultation: sales@meehaan.com

## International Export Capability
MEEHAAN is an export-ready supplier serving international markets:
- **Export Markets**: United States, Germany, United Kingdom, and expanding to additional EU countries
- **Logistics**: DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) and CIF arrangements available
- **Documentation**: Familiar with HS codes, GSTIN compliance, customs procedures
- **GSTIN**: 27ACXPH9352F1Z2 (Maharashtra, India)
- **Certifications**: ISO standards met for export markets, RoHS compliance, REACH compliance
- **Lead Times**: Standard 15-30 days for standard products, expedited options available

International buyers can request quotes with full technical support and compliance documentation.
